spans.text: All information disclosed by a Party or by Affiliates of a Party to the other Party or its respective Affiliates orally, electronically, writing or by any other means during the data sharing negotiations shall be considered as confidential unless expressly stated otherwise by the disclosing Party.

arguments.label: Entailment
arguments.explanation: The clause explicitly states that Confidential Information is considered confidential only if expressly stated by the Disclosing Party, which entails that all such information must be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.
